name: eventcheckin
author: Taako
description: Discord event registration with a Create Event form button, saved-template dropdown, event images, confirm-before-RSVP requirement buttons, fillable roles with per-role requirements and waitlists, persistent RSVP and check-in controls, recurring drafts, ICS calendar exports, native Discord scheduled events, capacity limits, automatic waitlists and promotion, reminders, attendance/no-show finalization, role rewards, and CSV exports.
install_msg: EventCheckin loaded. Run `[p]eventcheckin panel #channel` to post a Create Event button; staff with Manage Events click it, fill in a short form, and the event is posted. Use `[p]eventcheckin channel #events` to choose where events are announced. Every event post has a Manage button for staff (image, requirements, roles, save as template).
short: RSVPs, waitlists, reminders, attendance check-ins, no-shows, and rewards.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores event and template configuration, schema version, channel/message/role IDs, optional source type and record IDs, event creator IDs, attendee Discord user IDs, RSVP/waitlist/check-in/no-show states, cancellation reasons, notes, timestamps, and staff actor IDs. CSV attendance reports are generated on demand.
